structured_output.what_is_happening: A pump.fun token called "Pokémon Dollar" (₽) was created at 02:16:19Z on 2026-09-23. GMGN shows it graduating to PumpSwap in the same second it was created, which usually means one bundled buy filled the whole bonding curve. In about 44 minutes it rose roughly 560% to a ~$318k market cap with ~$183k volume. It has no description, no X or Telegram, and 0 pump.fun replies. Its only "website" is the Bulbapedia wiki page on in-game currency. GMGN counts 104 bundler wallets, and bundlers make up 91% of top traders. Fresh wallets are 91% of traders and the logo image is duplicated 3 times. About 6 minutes earlier (02:10Z) another token with the identical name, ticker and Bulbapedia link (CfEK…) launched, quoted against Collector Crypt's CARDS token. It was at ~$112k market cap. I found no news, X post, Reddit thread or real-world event that explains the name. The theme loosely fits Pokémon activity already underway: the 30th Celebration card set came out on Sept 16, and Collector Crypt is running its September gacha event. By the last GeckoTerminal windows, volume was falling fast: $5k in the last 5 minutes against $34k in the last 15 and $183k in the hour.

narrative.description: A generic Pokémon joke: the in-game currency ₽/Pokédollar as a token. The only nearby context is the Pokémon TCG 30th Celebration set and the tokenized Pokémon card trade on Solana (Collector Crypt / CARDS). I found no specific event, viral post or announcement about a 'Pokémon Dollar' today.
narrative.why_spreading: Nothing organic that I could find. The rise looks driven by the launch itself: an instant graduation with bundled buys and a wave of fresh wallets, plus the Pokémon brand pulling in pump.fun traders. The same name was launched at least five times within ~11 minutes, which is typical of copy-launching, not a story spreading.

token_connection.why_this_token: It is currently the largest same-name token by market cap and liquidity, and it is the pump.fun/PumpSwap version, which gets the most attention from pump.fun traders. There is no official link, socials or community to make it the canonical one.
token_connection.competing_tokens: CfEK…kzbQ launched ~6 minutes earlier (02:10Z) with the same name, ticker and Bulbapedia link, paired with CARDS on Raydium (~$112k market cap, $108k hourly volume). GPCw…, 7wG9… and 6tho… are near-dead copies launched within minutes.

authenticity.evidence: GMGN reports 104 bundler wallets, a 91.4% bundler share among top traders and 91% fresh wallets. Creation and migration happened in the same second, meaning the bonding curve was bought through at launch. The image is duplicated 3 times, there are zero pump.fun replies, no socials, and only 5 GMGN page visits. Web and X searches for the contract address and name found nothing.
authenticity.uncertainty: I have no X post data, and search engines index X poorly. Private Telegram call channels could be driving buyers and I cannot see them. The 1,412 unique buyers from GeckoTerminal may include real retail traders mixed in with bundle and bot wallets.

structural_risks: Bundlers are 91% of top traders, so they could dump quickly into ~$50k of liquidity
91% fresh wallets suggests farmed or sybil wallets
A same-name competitor launched earlier and splits attention
Volume is decelerating sharply: m5 $5k vs m15 $34k vs h1 $183k
Liquidity is only ~16% of market cap and there is no community or socials to hold buyers

structured_output.counterargument: Pokémon is one of the strongest meme brands, and Pokémon card trading on Solana (Collector Crypt) is active this month. So a clean ₽ ticker could become the default "Pokémon money" coin. This token already leads its copies by market cap and liquidity, the LP is 100% burned, the dev holds only 0.2%, and top-10 holders own ~19–26%. More than 1,400 unique buyers in the first hour is well above typical noise. If a KOL or the Collector Crypt community picks up this version, it could run again.

How much of the bundled supply has already been sold

source_coverage.notes: Searches for the contract address, name and ticker, including site:x.com, found no posts about this token. The X hits were unrelated old Pokédollar posts or accounts, and an X status page returned 402. News turned up only general Pokémon TCG and Collector Crypt context. The project site is just the Bulbapedia currency wiki page. I fetched the pump.fun API and DexScreener for this token and for competitor CfEK. I did not search Discord.

structured_output.thesis: This looks like a bundled pump.fun launch of a generic Pokémon-currency joke that graduated instantly, with no identifiable trigger, no socials and no community. A same-name token launched earlier. Volume is already dropping off a cliff, and the bundlers and fresh wallets dominating trading give a high chance the attention fades during the window.
